Title: VeroScript Setup
Heading: Install VeroScript
Subtitle: Choose the components and installation locations.
RuntimeDescription: Includes veroscript, LSP, DAP, standard library and localization resources.
ExamplesDescription: Optional examples for this product, installed in the examples folder under the selected product root.
AddToPath: Add the standalone VeroScript runtime to my user PATH
AddToPathDescription: Optional and disabled by default. During an update, clear this option to remove the installer-owned entry, or change the runtime location to move it.
SdkSubtitle: Choose the developer components to install.
SdkDescription: Components are installed into separate folders under one versioned SDK root.
SdkCoreDescription: Core language and Tooling headers/libraries, CMake integration, CLI and development assets. Language integrations and examples are separate modules.
InteropSdkDescription: Stable C ABI header, shared/import libraries and CMake integration. Examples are an optional module.
WebAssemblySdkDescription: UI-free WebAssembly modules and JavaScript/TypeScript API declarations.
DocsDescription: VeroScript docs and markdown references for developers.
SymbolsDescription: PDB files for diagnosing native and managed crashes and stack traces.
SdkInstallRootDescription: Each SDK product installs its selected modules under an independent versioned root.
